documents.title: Sharp County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 65 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance Section VI maximum appropriated amounts; categories from each office page's '2026 BUDGET' block column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
